newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's BNDES chooses power sell-off advisers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's BNDES chooses power sell-off advisers.

text.p: A consortia led by local investment bank Banco Fator was awarded a contract to advise on the selloff of Manaus and Boa Vista power systems, Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said on Thursday.

The consortia will be in charge of the so-called B Service to make a financial, economic and technical evaluation of the assets and design a privatization model for the power plants, said Sebastiao Bergamini, head of a BNDES committee which chooses advisors on Brazil's privatizations.
A group led by Maxima consulting firm won the contract for the so-called A Service, which is restricted to the financial, economic and technical evaluation of the power plants.
The names of the winning groups are expected to be published in Brazil's Official Gazette on Monday and the contracts are due to be signed in the first half of March, said Bergamini.

Manaus and Boa Vista power systems belong to Eletronorte, a subsidiary of federal Eletrobras. Manaus system comprises three thermoelectrical units, one hydroelectrical plant and a distribution system, while Boa Vista is made up of three thermoelectrical units.
Bergamini said the selloff of Manaus and Boa Vista power systems are not expected until the second half of August.
